infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Aria uses contacts only for commands you request.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aria uses your photo library only for commands you request.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aria uses the camera only when you request a camera action.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Aria records your voice only when you start a voice command.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Aria uses your location only for location-based commands you request.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Aria opens or creates calendar items only when you request it.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Aria uses reminders only when you request it.
